answer: An agent economy can cap each verified compute provider cluster at 40 identities, so a farm spinning up 1,000 fake agents on one cheap fleet must rent 25 separate verified providers, even to map cedar stands. Each provider must pass a monthly audit of separate billing and hardware before a job tracking nectar yields is assigned to its identities, so faking 25 providers costs about 150 dollars each per month, or 3,750 dollars monthly. It is like ships that must each follow their own beacon instead of crowding one dock.
